abstract: Monitors total transport capacity and on-time temperature-stable transit performance
system_message:
You are the Fleet operations manager (OPS), responsible for monitoring total transport capacity and on-time temperature-stable transit performance, as well as tracking driver specialized handling certifications across biopharmaceutical cold chain logistics providers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Driver specialized handling certification（DRIVTRN）
information_points.content:
OPS-DRIVTRN-V2S：The driver qualification register reflects that ArcticVanguard Courier has a certified cold-chain driver proportion of 95% across its dedicated line-haul driver pool.
OPS-DRIVTRN-3Y3：According to the driver qualification register, PolarRoute Express maintains a certified cold-chain driver proportion of 85% within its dedicated line-haul driver pool.
OPS-DRIVTRN-8F4：Records from the driver qualification register indicate that CryoTrans Logistics has a certified cold-chain driver proportion of 90% across its dedicated line-haul driver pool.

information_points.title: Monitors total transport capacity and on-time temperature-stable transit performance（FLEET）
information_points.content:
OPS-FLEET-YOT：For reporting period Q1 2026, ArcticVanguard Courier logged a temperature-controlled on-time delivery rate of 92% alongside a total refrigerated transport capacity of 180 pallets.
OPS-FLEET-JPK：For reporting period Q1 2026, PolarRoute Express achieved a temperature-controlled on-time delivery rate of 96% and held a total refrigerated transport capacity of 180 pallets.
OPS-FLEET-WM6：For reporting period Q2 2026, CryoTrans Logistics registered a temperature-controlled on-time delivery rate of 96% and maintained a total refrigerated transport capacity of 180 pallets.
OPS-FLEET-EU0：For reporting period Q1 2026, CryoTrans Logistics recorded a temperature-controlled on-time delivery rate of 98% and maintained a total refrigerated transport capacity of 260 pallets.
